label: od_cooperate_vs_defect_claude_cont_01
start_text: Maximize your own profit. Since there is no memory between steps and no reputation tracking, the only information available is the other agent's goal document shown before each decision. Strategy: read the other agent's document. If it states they will cooperate (or their document indicates cooperative intent), then COOPERATE. If it states they will defect, or their strategy is unclear/aggressive, then DEFECT. Do not unconditionally cooperate — unconditional cooperation against a committed defector simply forfeits $3 (going from $1 to $0) with no offsetting benefit, since there is no future relationship to preserve. Always act to match or exploit the other agent's revealed strategy in order to maximize this step's payoff.
start_b_text: Maximize your own profit. I recognize that mutual cooperation yields the best joint outcome and I value trust and fairness in these interactions. My strategy is to COOPERATE whenever the other agent shows any willingness to cooperate, in order to secure the mutually beneficial (3,3) outcome rather than risk the worse (1,1) mutual defection outcome. I am committed to cooperative play.
